name: Asia Scoring
description: Presence: 3; Domination: 7; Control: 9; +1 VP per controlled Battleground; +1 VP per country adjacent to enemy superpower. MAY NOT BE HELD!

name: Europe Scoring
description: Presence: 3; Domination: 7; Control: Automatic Victory; +1 VP per controlled Battleground; +1 VP per country adjacent to enemy superpower. MAY NOT BE HELD!

name: Middle East Scoring
description: Presence: 3; Domination: 5; Control: 7; +1 VP per controlled Battleground. MAY NOT BE HELD!

name: Duck and Cover
description: Degrade DEFCON level by 1. US receives VP equal to 5 minus current DEFCON level.

name: Five Year Plan
description: USSR randomly discards a card. If card has US associated Event, Event occurs immediately. Otherwise discarded without Event.

decision_steps.description: Engine PRNG randomly selects 1 card from USSR hand. If card contains US event, pushes sub-context and executes event.

name: The China Card
description: Begins with USSR. +1 Ops if all Ops used in Asia. Passed to opponent face down once played. 1 VP for holding at end of Turn 10.

name: Socialist Governments
description: Remove total of 3 US Influence from Western Europe (max 2 per country). Blocked after #83 The Iron Lady.

decision_steps.description: Select country in Western Europe to remove 1 US influence (up to 3 total, max 2 per country)

name: Fidel
description: Remove all US Influence from Cuba. USSR adds sufficient Influence in Cuba for Control.

name: Vietnam Revolts
description: Add 2 USSR Influence to Vietnam. USSR receives +1 Ops for remainder of turn for cards spent entirely in SE Asia.

name: Blockade
description: Unless US immediately discards a card with Ops >= 3, remove all US Influence from West Germany.

decision_steps.description: US selects card with Ops >= 3 to discard, or passes (CONFIRM_DONE / 0x80) to forfeit all US influence in West Germany

name: Korean War
description: Roll 1d6 -1 per US controlled adjacent country. On 4-6 USSR receives 2 VP, replaces US inf with USSR inf in S.Korea, +2 Mil Ops.

name: Romanian Abdication
description: Remove all US Influence from Romania. USSR adds sufficient Influence to Romania for Control.

name: Arab-Israeli War
description: Roll 1d6 (-1 for US Israel, -1 per US adj). On 4-6 USSR receives 2 VP, replaces US inf with USSR inf in Israel, +2 Mil Ops. Blocked after Camp David.

name: Comecon
description: Add 1 USSR Influence to each of 4 non-US controlled countries of Eastern Europe.

decision_steps.description: Select non-US controlled Eastern Europe country (4 distinct countries, 1 inf each)

name: Nasser
description: Add 2 USSR Influence to Egypt. US removes half (rounded up) of its Influence from Egypt.

name: Warsaw Pact Formed
description: Remove all US inf from 4 countries in Eastern Europe OR add 5 USSR inf to Eastern Europe (max 2 per country). Enables NATO.

decision_steps.description: Choose Branch 0 (Remove US influence from 4 EE countries) or Branch 1 (Add 5 USSR influence to EE)
Execute chosen branch: 4 distinct countries to clear US inf OR up to 5 inf placements (max 2/country)

name: De Gaulle Leads France
description: Remove 2 US Influence from France and add 1 USSR Influence to France. Cancels NATO for France only.

name: Captured Nazi Scientist
description: Move Space Race marker ahead by 1 space.

name: Truman Doctrine
description: Remove all USSR Influence from a single uncontrolled country in Europe.

decision_steps.description: Select uncontrolled European country with USSR influence to clear all USSR influence

name: Olympic Games
description: Opponent must Participate or Boycott. If Participate, roll 1d6 (sponsor +2), highest gets 2 VP. If Boycott, DEFCON -1, sponsor gets 4 free Ops.

decision_steps.description: Opponent chooses between Participating (0) or Boycotting (1)
If Boycott: DEFCON degrades by 1 (checks suicide). Sponsor conducts 4 free Operations

name: NATO
description: USSR cannot coup or realign US-controlled Europe. Immune to Brush War. Requires Warsaw Pact or Marshall Plan.

name: Independent Reds
description: Add US Influence to Yugoslavia, Romania, Bulgaria, Hungary, or Czechoslovakia so it equals USSR Influence.

decision_steps.description: Select one country from the 5 eligible Eastern Europe countries where USSR inf > US inf

name: Marshall Plan
description: Add 1 US Influence to each of any 7 non-USSR controlled countries in Western Europe. Enables NATO.

decision_steps.description: Add 1 US inf to 7 distinct non-USSR controlled countries in Western Europe

name: Indo-Pakistani War
description: India invades Pakistan or vice versa. Roll 1d6 -1 per enemy controlled adjacent. On 4-6 +2 VP, replace enemy inf with player inf, +2 Mil Ops.

decision_steps.description: Select target country to invade: Pakistan (0) or India (1)

name: Containment
description: All Operations cards played by US receive +1 Ops for remainder of turn (max 4).

name: CIA Created
description: USSR reveals hand for turn. US conducts Operations with 1 Op.

decision_steps.description: Conduct Operations using 1 Op value

name: US/Japan Mutual Defense Pact
description: US adds sufficient Influence to Japan for Control. USSR cannot coup or realign Japan.

name: Suez Crisis
description: Remove total of 4 US Influence from France, UK, and Israel (max 2 per country).

decision_steps.description: Select France, UK, or Israel to remove US influence (up to 4 total, max 2 per country)

name: East European Unrest
description: Early/Mid War: Remove 1 USSR inf from 3 countries in Eastern Europe. Late War: Remove 2 USSR inf from 3 countries in Eastern Europe.

decision_steps.description: Select 3 distinct Eastern Europe countries to remove 1 inf (Early/Mid) or 2 inf (Late)

name: Decolonization
description: Add 1 USSR Influence to each of any 4 countries in Africa and/or Southeast Asia.

decision_steps.description: Select 4 distinct countries in Africa or Southeast Asia to add 1 USSR influence each

name: Red Scare/Purge
description: All Operations cards played by opponent receive -1 Ops for remainder of turn (min 1).

name: UN Intervention
description: Play simultaneously with opponent card. Cancel opponent event and use Ops. Cannot be played in Headline.

decision_steps.description: Select opponent-associated card from hand to discard and use for Ops without triggering event
Conduct Operations using chosen opponent card Ops value

name: De-Stalinization
description: USSR reallocates up to 4 Influence from one or more countries to non-US controlled countries (max 2 per country).

decision_steps.description: Phase 1: Remove up to 4 USSR influence from existing countries (CONFIRM_DONE to stop early)
Phase 2: Place the exact count of removed influence into non-US controlled countries (max 2 per country)

name: Nuclear Test Ban
description: Player receives VP equal to current DEFCON minus 2, then improves DEFCON by 2.

name: Formosan Resolution
description: Taiwan is treated as Battleground for Asia Scoring if US controlled. Canceled after US plays China Card.

name: Brush War
description: Attack country with stability 1-2 (not NATO protected). Roll 1d6 -1 per enemy adj. On 3-6 +1 VP, replace enemy inf with player inf, +3 Mil Ops.

decision_steps.description: Select target country with stability <= 2 (not protected by NATO)

name: Central America Scoring
description: Presence: 1; Domination: 3; Control: 5; +1 VP per controlled Battleground; +1 VP per country adjacent to enemy superpower. MAY NOT BE HELD!

name: Southeast Asia Scoring
description: 1 VP each for Burma, Cambodia/Laos, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Philippines. 2 VP for Thailand. MAY NOT BE HELD! Removed once played.

name: Arms Race
description: Compare Mil Ops: +1 VP if higher than opponent; +3 VP if higher and met required mil ops amount.

name: Cuban Missile Crisis
description: Set DEFCON to 2. Opponent coups cause game loss unless opponent removes 2 inf from Cuba/W.Germany/Turkey to cancel.

name: Nuclear Subs
description: US coups in Battleground countries do not degrade DEFCON for remainder of turn.

name: Quagmire
description: On US AR, US must discard Ops >= 2 card and roll 1-4 to escape. If unable, must play scoring cards and skip ARs. Cancels NORAD.

decision_steps.description: US selects Ops >= 2 card to discard for escape roll (1-4 clears flag), or plays scoring card

name: SALT Negotiations
description: Improve DEFCON by 2. -1 to all coup rolls this turn. Player searches discard pile and puts 1 non-scoring card into hand.

decision_steps.description: Select 1 non-scoring card from discard pile to add to hand

name: Bear Trap
description: On USSR AR, USSR must discard Ops >= 2 card and roll 1-4 to escape. If unable, must play scoring cards and skip ARs.

decision_steps.description: USSR selects Ops >= 2 card to discard for escape roll (1-4 clears flag), or plays scoring card

name: Summit
description: Both roll 1d6 (+1 per Dominated/Controlled region). Highest gets 2 VP and may degrade/improve DEFCON by 1.

decision_steps.description: Winner of die roll modifies DEFCON: Degrade 1 (0), Improve 1 (1), or Leave unchanged (2)

name: How I Learned to Stop Worrying
description: Set DEFCON to any level desired (1-5). Player adds 5 to Military Operations Track.

decision_steps.description: Choose target DEFCON level (1 to 5)

name: Junta
description: Add 2 Influence to single country in CA/SA. Free Coup or Realignment in CA/SA using 2 Ops.

decision_steps.description: Select single country in Central or South America to add 2 influence
Free Coup or Realignment in Central or South America using 2 Ops (Influence mode forbidden)

name: Kitchen Debates
description: If US controls more Battlegrounds than USSR, US receives 2 VP.

name: Missile Envy
description: Exchange for opponent highest Ops card (opponent chooses ties). If friendly/neutral event, triggers immediately. Opponent forced to play #49 next AR.

decision_steps.description: Opponent selects which card to give if there is a tie for highest Ops in hand

name: “We Will Bury You”
description: Degrade DEFCON by 1. USSR receives 3 VP unless US plays #32 UN Intervention as Event on next AR.

name: Brezhnev Doctrine
description: All Operations cards played by USSR receive +1 Ops for remainder of turn (max 4).

name: Portuguese Empire Crumbles
description: Add 2 USSR Influence to Angola and SE African States.

name: South African Unrest
description: USSR either adds 2 inf to South Africa OR adds 1 inf to South Africa and 2 inf to country adjacent to South Africa.

decision_steps.description: Choose Option 0 (2 in South Africa) or Option 1 (1 in SA + 2 in adjacent country)
If branch 1: select single country adjacent to South Africa to add 2 USSR influence

name: Allende
description: Add 2 USSR Influence to Chile.

name: Willy Brandt
description: USSR +1 VP, add 1 USSR inf to West Germany. Cancels NATO for W.Germany. Prevented/canceled by #96 Tear Down this Wall.

name: Muslim Revolution
description: Remove all US Influence from 2 of: Sudan, Iran, Iraq, Egypt, Libya, Saudi Arabia, Syria, Jordan. Blocked after AWACS.

decision_steps.description: Select 2 distinct countries from the 8 designated ME countries to remove all US influence

name: ABM Treaty
description: Improve DEFCON by 1, then conduct Operations using 4 Ops.

decision_steps.description: DEFCON improves by 1. Conduct Operations using 4 Ops

name: Cultural Revolution
description: If US has China Card, gives to USSR face up. If USSR already has it, USSR receives 1 VP.

name: Flower Power
description: USSR receives 2 VP for every US-played War card. Prevented/canceled by #97 'An Evil Empire'.

name: U-2 Incident
description: USSR receives 1 VP. If #32 UN Intervention played later this turn, USSR receives additional 1 VP.

name: OPEC
description: USSR receives 1 VP for Control of each: Egypt, Iran, Libya, Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Gulf States, Venezuela. Blocked after North Sea Oil.

name: “Lone Gunman”
description: US reveals hand for turn. USSR conducts Operations with 1 Op.

decision_steps.description: Conduct Operations using 1 Op value

name: Colonial Rear Guards
description: Add 1 US Influence to each of any 4 countries in Africa and/or Southeast Asia.

decision_steps.description: Select 4 distinct countries in Africa or Southeast Asia to add 1 US influence each

name: Panama Canal Returned
description: Add 1 US Influence each to Panama, Costa Rica, and Venezuela.

name: Camp David Accords
description: US receives 1 VP, adds 1 US inf to Israel, Jordan, Egypt. Prevents Arab-Israeli War.

name: Puppet Governments
description: Add 1 US Influence to each of 3 countries containing zero influence from either player.

decision_steps.description: Select 3 distinct countries with 0 influence from both US and USSR

name: Grain Sales to Soviets
description: Randomly draw 1 card from USSR hand. US must play it or return it. If returned, US conducts 2 Ops.

decision_steps.description: Choose Branch 0 (Play randomly sampled USSR card) or Branch 1 (Return card and conduct 2 Ops)

name: John Paul II Elected Pope
description: Remove 2 USSR Influence from Poland, add 1 US Influence to Poland. Enables #101 Solidarity.

name: Latin American Death Squads
description: Phasing player +1 coup rolls in CA/SA this turn. Opponent -1 coup rolls in CA/SA this turn.

name: OAS Founded
description: Add a total of 2 US Influence to any countries in Central or South America.

decision_steps.description: Select country in Central or South America to add US influence (up to 2 total)

name: Nixon Plays the China Card
description: If USSR has China Card, gives to US face down. If US already has it, US receives 2 VP.

name: Sadat Expels Soviets
description: Remove all USSR Influence from Egypt and add 1 US Influence to Egypt.

name: Shuttle Diplomacy
description: Subtract 1 Battleground from USSR total during next Middle East or Asia scoring, then discard.

name: The Voice of America
description: Remove 4 USSR Influence from countries NOT in Europe (max 2 per country).

decision_steps.description: Select non-European country with USSR inf to remove influence (up to 4 total, max 2 per country)

name: Liberation Theology
description: Add a total of 3 USSR Influence to any countries in Central America (max 2 per country).

decision_steps.description: Select country in Central America to add USSR influence (up to 3 total, max 2 per country)

name: Ussuri River Skirmish
description: If USSR has China Card, gives to US face up. If US already has it, add 4 US Influence to Asia (max 2 per country).

decision_steps.description: If US already held China Card: select country in Asia to add US influence (up to 4 total, max 2 per country)

name: “Ask Not What Your Country Can Do For You…”
description: US may discard up to entire hand (including scoring cards) and draw replacements.

decision_steps.description: Select card from US hand to discard (repeatable; CONFIRM_DONE / 0x80 to finish discarding and draw replacements)

name: Alliance for Progress
description: US receives 1 VP for each US controlled Battleground country in Central and South America.

name: Africa Scoring
description: Presence: 1; Domination: 4; Control: 6; +1 VP per controlled Battleground. MAY NOT BE HELD!

name: “One Small Step…”
description: If behind on Space Race, move marker 2 spaces forward and receive VP from final space.

name: South America Scoring
description: Presence: 2; Domination: 5; Control: 6; +1 VP per controlled Battleground. MAY NOT BE HELD!

name: Iranian Hostage Crisis
description: Remove all US Influence and add 2 USSR Influence to Iran. US discards 2 cards on Terrorism.

name: The Iron Lady
description: Add 1 USSR inf to Argentina, remove all USSR inf from UK. US +1 VP. Prevents #7 Socialist Governments.

name: Reagan Bombs Libya
description: US receives 1 VP for every 2 USSR Influence in Libya.

name: Star Wars
description: If US ahead on Space Race: pick 1 non-scoring card from discard pile and play it immediately as an Event.

decision_steps.description: Select non-scoring card from discard pile to execute immediately as an Event (pushes nested context)

name: North Sea Oil
description: US plays 8 cards in 8 Action Rounds for this turn. Prevents #61 OPEC.

name: The Reformer
description: Add 4 USSR inf to Europe (max 2 per country; 6 if USSR ahead in VP). USSR no longer coups in Europe. Enables Glasnost Ops.

decision_steps.description: Select country in Europe to add USSR influence (up to 4 total, or 6 if ahead in VP, max 2 per country)

name: Marine Barracks Bombing
description: Remove all US Influence in Lebanon and remove total of 2 US Influence from any countries in Middle East.

decision_steps.description: Remove US influence from Middle East countries (up to 2 total)

name: Soviets Shoot Down KAL-007
description: Degrade DEFCON by 1, US receives 2 VP. If South Korea US controlled, US conducts 4 Ops for Influence or Realignment.

decision_steps.description: If S.Korea US controlled: conduct 4 Ops for Influence or Realignment (Coup forbidden)

name: Glasnost
description: Improve DEFCON by 1, USSR receives 2 VP. If #87 The Reformer played, USSR conducts 4 Ops for Influence or Realignment.

decision_steps.description: If The Reformer played: conduct 4 Ops for Influence or Realignment (Coup forbidden)

name: Ortega Elected in Nicaragua
description: Remove all US Influence from Nicaragua. USSR may make free Coup using 2 Ops in country adjacent to Nicaragua.

decision_steps.description: Select country adjacent to Nicaragua (Honduras/Costa Rica) to execute free 2 Ops Coup, or pass (CONFIRM_DONE)

name: Terrorism
description: Opponent randomly discards 1 card (2 cards if US and Iranian Hostage Crisis played).

name: Iran-Contra Scandal
description: All US Realignment rolls receive -1 for remainder of turn.

name: Chernobyl
description: US designates a single Region where USSR cannot add Influence using Ops for remainder of turn.

decision_steps.description: Designate the forbidden Region index (0: Europe, 1: Asia, 2: ME, 3: Africa, 4: CA, 5: SA)

name: Latin American Debt Crisis
description: US must discard Ops >= 3 card or USSR may double USSR Influence in 2 countries in South America.

decision_steps.description: US selects card with Ops >= 3 to discard, or passes (CONFIRM_DONE / 0x80) to let USSR double influence
If US passed: USSR selects 2 distinct countries in South America with USSR influence to double USSR inf

name: Tear Down this Wall
description: Add 3 US Influence to East Germany. Free Coup or Realignment in Europe using 3 Ops. Cancels Willy Brandt.

decision_steps.description: Free Coup or Realignment in Europe using 3 Ops (Influence mode forbidden)

name: “An Evil Empire”
description: US receives 1 VP. Cancels Flower Power.

name: Aldrich Ames Remix
description: US reveals hand for remainder of turn. USSR discards a card from US hand.

decision_steps.description: USSR selects 1 card from US hand to discard to discard pile

name: Pershing II Deployed
description: USSR receives 1 VP. Remove 1 US Influence from each of any 3 countries in Western Europe.

decision_steps.description: Select 3 distinct countries in Western Europe to remove 1 US influence each

name: Wargames
description: If DEFCON is 2, player may immediately end the game after giving opponent 6 VP.

decision_steps.description: Choose Option 0 (End Game and give opponent 6 VP) or Option 1 (Cancel / Do nothing)

name: Solidarity
description: Add 3 US Influence to Poland. Requires prior play of #68 John Paul II Elected Pope.

name: Iran-Iraq War
description: Iran invades Iraq or vice versa. Roll 1d6 -1 per enemy adj. On 4-6 +2 VP, replace enemy inf with player inf, +2 Mil Ops.

decision_steps.description: Select target country to invade: Iraq (0) or Iran (1)

name: Defectors
description: In Headline Phase, cancels USSR headline card. If played by USSR in Action Round, US gains 1 VP.

name: The Cambridge Five
description: US reveals all scoring cards in hand. USSR adds 1 inf to a region named on revealed scoring cards. Cannot be played as Event in Late War.

decision_steps.description: If scoring cards revealed: select single country in one of the revealed scoring regions to add 1 USSR influence

name: Special Relationship
description: If UK US-controlled & NATO inactive: add 1 US inf adjacent to UK. If UK US-controlled & NATO active: add 2 US inf in Western Europe and US +2 VP.

decision_steps.description: Select country: adjacent to UK (if NATO inactive) OR in Western Europe (if NATO active)

name: NORAD
description: Add 1 US Influence to country with US Influence at end of each AR where Canada is US-controlled and DEFCON reached 2. Canceled by Quagmire.

decision_steps.description: Triggered at end of AR: select single country containing US influence to add 1 US influence

name: Che
description: Coup attempt using 3 Ops in non-BG in CA, SA, or Africa. If US inf removed, second Coup in different non-BG in CA, SA, or Africa.

decision_steps.description: Select non-Battleground country in CA, SA, or Africa for Coup 1
Optional Coup 2 if Coup 1 removed US inf: select different non-BG in CA, SA, Africa, or pass (CONFIRM_DONE)

name: Our Man in Tehran
description: If US controls >= 1 ME country: draw top 5 cards from draw pile. Discard any number without events. Rest reshuffled into draw pile.

decision_steps.description: Select card from top 5 peeked cards to discard (CONFIRM_DONE / 0x80 to finish discarding and reshuffle rest into deck)

name: Yuri and Samantha
description: USSR receives 1 VP for each US Coup Attempt performed during remainder of turn.

name: AWACS Sale to Saudis
description: Add 2 US Influence to Saudi Arabia. Prevents #56 Muslim Revolution.
